downloadApp.bannerSubtitle: Official APK for faster gameplay & instant match alerts
downloadApp.dialogSubtitle: Official guide to installing the Booyah Win APK safely
downloadApp.step1Desc: Tap "Download App". If your browser displays "File might be harmful", tap "Download anyway". This is a standard Android prompt for apps downloaded outside Google Play.
downloadApp.step2Desc: Open the downloaded file from your notifications or Downloads folder. If prompted, tap "Settings" and enable "Allow from this source", then return and tap "Install".
downloadApp.step3Desc: If Google Play Protect warns that the app is unrecognized, tap "More details" followed by "Install anyway". Our APK is 100% verified, virus-free, and safe.
downloadApp.safetyWarningDesc: The APK file should come ONLY from this official site. Never download or accept Booyah Win APK files from third-party links, Telegram, or WhatsApp.
aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.heroSubtitle: India's Premier Free Fire Esports Platform
aboutUs.heroDesc: Booyah Win is dedicated to transforming grassroots mobile gaming into a professional competitive arena. We host daily custom rooms, scrims, and grand tournaments for players across India.
aboutUs.pillarAntiCheatDesc: Zero tolerance for emulators, hacks, or modified game clients. Every match is monitored by tournament staff, and end-game scoreboards undergo manual screenshot verification.
aboutUs.pillarSkillDesc: Booyah Win operates in full compliance with Indian laws regarding games of skill. Match outcomes depend entirely on individual aim, team coordination, strategy, and game sense.
aboutUs.pillarPayoutDesc: Your winnings belong to you. We process automated and verified withdrawals directly to your UPI ID without hidden deductions or unnecessary holding periods.
aboutUs.pillarSupportDesc: Have questions or encountered a room dispute? Our dedicated support team is available daily via WhatsApp and email to resolve issues promptly.
aboutUs.legalNoticeDesc: Booyah Win is operated by Booyah Win Technologies. All Free Fire game names, trademarks, and logos are property of Garena International. Booyah Win is an independent tournament organizer and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garena.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.lastUpdated: Last updated: October 2026. Booyah Win is committed to safeguarding player personal data and maintaining the highest standards of financial security and fairness.
privacyPolicy.sec1Desc: When you register and participate in tournaments on Booyah Win, we collect:
privacyPolicy.sec1AccountDetailsText: Full name, mobile number, email address, username, and date of birth (to enforce 18+ legal eligibility).
privacyPolicy.sec1GameInfoText: Free Fire User ID (UID) and In-Game Name (IGN) to verify room entry and distribute prizes.
privacyPolicy.sec1FinancialInfoText: Payout UPI ID (we never collect or store banking passwords, debit card PINs, or OTPs).
privacyPolicy.sec1SecurityInfoText: IP address, device fingerprints, and security tokens to prevent fraud and multi-accounting.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item1: Facilitating custom tournament match rooms, seat reservations, and team invites.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item2: Processing entry fees and crediting instant kill and placement winnings to your wallet.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item3: Auditing gameplay scores via screenshot verification to eliminate cheating or hacking.
privacyPolicy.sec2Item4: Sending essential OTP verification codes and critical match schedule notifications.
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc: Booyah Win will never sell, lease, or monetize your personal information or contact details to third-party marketing agencies or advertisers. Your data is used exclusively to operate your tournament experience.
privacyPolicy.sec4Desc: All deposit and withdrawal transactions use secure Indian banking UPI networks. Wallet balances are segregated into deposited, promotional cashback, and withdrawable winnings to guarantee exact financial reconciliation.
privacyPolicy.sec5Desc: Players have full rights to inspect their account profile, update mobile or UPI credentials (subject to 30-day anti-tampering cooldowns), and request permanent account deletion by contacting Customer Support.
privacyPolicy.questionsDesc: If you have inquiries about our privacy policies or data protection measures, contact our grievance team anytime.
